items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1968-10-21
items.q: I would be playing my part, the Cranet part

ctx.x: it's a funeral, I'll play at the funeral, and, everybody had the music, and I would be playing my part, the Cranet part, it was all very different from what the music would be, I understand. I, I, I, I played a little, I played a little reddest, which is all here, on the E flat, cranny, on the street. And you could hear the foot, because, the ladder was a man, when he, he, he, he was always on the outside, and you see him walk up, walking up and down, and up the band. Mm-hmm.
